assessments.reasoning: The PDF purpose paragraph explicitly addresses assembler source syntax and writing source programs. Its machine-instruction paragraph delegates detailed machine definitions to other manuals.

challenge.method: Read the exact SC26-4940-07 purpose and applicability text with the separate original language-reference abstract, and compare the licensed product and source-language roles.
challenge.results: The direct IBM source and the original abstract identify the same subject scope. Mentioning a processor or an operating system does not make it the source language. The old source record correctly records a prior access failure, while the independent capture establishes current access.

limitations: Only the IBM High Level Assembler source-language scope of the inspected documentation is supported.
